diagnosis: The anomaly in this run is a moisture/latent one: zone1_relative_humidity climbs from 55.054 %RH to 77.920 %RH and leaves its 40..70 %RH reference band from hour 16 onwards, while zone1_latent_load rises with it from 118.251 W to 413.815 W. The dry-bulb signal zone1_air_temperature stays within 1.249 K of 24 degC over the same window (22.751..25.193 degC), so a diagnosis built on temperature alone would miss the excursion.

perturbation.note: No input is perturbed in this case; it is a baseline case.

title: Humid-climate latent load; the signal is moisture, not temperature
